subject: general
question: Who, being the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, takes the salute of various regiments of the Armed Forces during the march-past on the occasion of Republic Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **President of India** takes the **salute** during the march-past of various regiments of the **armed forces** on the occasion of **Republic Day.**
 
• The President of India is the** Commander-in-Chief **of the **Indian Armed Forces**, and hence, it is a tradition for him to take the salute during the Republic Day parade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** President of India** is elected by an** Electoral College **consisting of elected members of both houses of the **Parliament of India **and of the **Legislative Assemblies** of the States of India. 
 
• The **Defence Minister of India** is a member of the** Cabinet **and is responsible for the** Defence Ministry,** which is the ministry in charge of the armed forces of India.
 
• The **Prime Minister of India** is the leader of the **ruling party or coalition of parties** in the** Lok Sabha**, which is the lower house of the Parliament of India.
 
• The **Home Minister of India** is a member of the Cabinet and is responsible for the **Ministry of Home Affairs, **which is the ministry in charge of **internal security, law and order, and disaster management **in India.
